signIn.title: Sign in to Knowledge Kareem
signIn.subtitle: A private platform for member organisations. Use your work account.
signIn.domainNotAllowed: Knowledge Kareem is a private platform for specific organisations. If you believe this is a mistake, contact your organisation's administrator.
signIn.explain: No password and no emailed link. If your address is on your organisation's list you go straight in; if not, we tell you why.
signIn.carried: Scanned a session poster? After signing in you land on that session, not on the home page.

chooseOrg.title: Choose your organisation
chooseOrg.body: Your email is listed by more than one organisation. Choose yours — this choice is final and cannot be changed later.
chooseOrg.error: Your choice could not be saved. Try again.
chooseOrg.permanent: Your account stays in this organisation for good: there is no organisation switcher and no account that spans two.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.noMatch: Knowledge Kareem is a private platform for specific organisations. If you believe this is a mistake, contact your organisation's administrator.
noAccess.suspendedBody: Your data is retained. Contact your organisation's administrator to learn more.
noAccess.deactivatedBody: Contact your organisation's admin if you believe this is a mistake.
noAccess.platformTitle: This account belongs to no organisation
noAccess.platformBody: You are a platform administrator, and your way in is the platform console. An organisation's own screens do not open to a platform account, not even during a break-glass session.
noAccess.signedInNoMatch: You signed in as <email></email> — this account is on no organisation's list.
